summary: RF05 frontend smoke: BalanceConverterCard idempotency + SSE 'rates_updated' live refresh. All 4 flows PASS. VIP (session smoke_session_vip_iter294) opened converter on /dashboard/assets, executed 5 USD → USDT once (exactly 1 POST /api/vip/convert), UI balance updated in-place (1000→995 USD, 100→104.5354 USDT). Admin edited scrub_test_USDT_USD (rate_vip 1.05→1.08) with pyotp 2FA; VIP tab observed SSE-triggered loadRates+loadDust within ~1s (rate_delta=1, dust_delta=1) WITHOUT reload. Preview dialog reflected the refreshed table. Rate then restored to 1.05 with a fresh TOTP code. Dust CTA correctly hidden (endpoint reports no_dust, items=0). Positive rows ordered by USDT equivalent DESC (USD, USDT). Zero console errors on the dashboard. No layout regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminRates edit dialog uses table row toggle logic that preserves rate_sell only when present in form; behavior fine for this test but worth guarding against accidental clearing when editing unrelated fields.
useConverterData ordering guards (dustSeqRef/ratesSeqRef) work as intended; observed single reload after SSE with correct latest state.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Converter card is rendered inside AssetsView and is toggled by [data-testid=assets-convert-btn] on /dashboard/assets (not shown on /dashboard root). Useful testids: assets-convert-btn, balance-converter-card, converter-row-{CODE}, converter-trigger-{CODE}, converter-to-code, converter-to-option-{CODE}, converter-amount, converter-max, confirm-converter, dust-sweep-open, admin-rates, edit-rate-{id}, rate-normal, rate-vip, rate-sell, save-rate-btn, totp-prompt-input, totp-prompt-confirm. SSE reload verified within ~1s of admin edit; assertion window used was 20s.
